safety_card.layout: Row based. Left: Large food thumbnail (80x80px, rounded-lg). Right: English Name (20px bold), Hindi Name (18px regular, text-secondary). Top-Right/Floating: Safety Badge.
safety_card.badge: Displays Icon + Text (e.g. 'Safe'). Uses respective safety color background and dark text for 7:1 contrast.
safety_card.clinical_tip: Text block below the name, 16px text-secondary.
safety_card.portion_limit: Highlighted in bold text, inline or separate row.

smart_swap_card.layout: Nested directly under a RED food card. Visually connected but distinct.
smart_swap_card.header: Contains 'Recommended Safe Swap' with a celebratory leaf icon.
smart_swap_card.content: Displays GREEN food suggestion, Hindi name, and 'Why this is better' clinical explanation.

ask_ai_button.type: Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent bottom bar button.

login_register.layout: Large input fields (56px height), bold labels (18px), high contrast. 'Login' and 'Register' toggles.
login_register.background_image: Use onboarding_hero image with heavy white/gradient overlay for readability.

search_results.layout: Vertical list of Safety Cards. High spacing (gap-16px) between items. Clear GREEN/YELLOW/RED visual rhythm.

food_detail.layout: Large hero image. Title section with Hindi + English. Safety badge large at top. Portion limit highlighted. Clinical tip section. If RED, Smart Swap Card prominently displayed at the bottom.

meal_log.layout: Date selector. List of logged foods. Cumulative daily safety summary (e.g., '2 Safe, 1 Caution').

ai_chat.layout: Large text bubbles (18px). Voice input button (64px). Clean background.

settings.layout: Large toggle for English/Hindi. High contrast text. Profile details.

accessibility.contrast: Text must maintain at least 7:1 ratio against background. Safety badges use dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 56px for primary CTAs, 44px for secondary.
accessibility.color_coding: Color is never the sole indicator. Badges must use distinct icons (Circle/Triangle/Octagon) and explicit text labels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
accessibility.language: Hindi Devanagari script must be well-supported and render beautifully alongside English.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app uses React Native elements optimized for touch (min 56px CTAs). Implement clear visual contrast (7:1 for text). Use vector icons for the shapes in safety badges. Use StyleSheet or NativeWind to map the provided colors and spacing. Ensure all buttons, inputs, and pressables have data-testid.
